svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Automation: n8n, MQTT, GitHub Actions, REST APIs, GoHighLevel. Data and ETL: Python, pandas, NumPy, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, MySQL, Supabase, Redis, Power BI. Backend: FastAPI, Django, NestJS, Express, Prisma, Go, C#. Web, mobile and IoT: React, Expo, TypeScript, Svelte, Tailwind CSS, ESP32, C++. DevOps and AI: Docker, Linux, Traefik, Vercel, Railway, Ollama, scikit-learn, Anthropic API.
